[Smash 4] When should one start looking into going competitive?

People will say that For Glory will never get you ready for the real thing. I agree that it will never be the best, but I think it is ok if thats all you can do for practice. As for how good should you be before you start playing competitively, thats a bad question. If you want to play with the big boys all you need is a controller that they will let you use and a positive attitude. let's be clear; you're not going to win EVO straight out of living room. You can, however, find a local scene and begin playing with them. You will instantly be improving at a more productive rate than For Glory. Don't be afraid to lose. Look at all the people that don't try, and know that you are better for trying! Remember every community will have a different local meta so global knowledge will be less important than a firm understanding of the players you will be playing. So lets wrap this up with a quick recap.

TL;DR! For Glory isn't really real! Find local smashers near you! Learn and have fun!

Is not playing with a GC controller a big deal?

It isn't a huge deal for most smaller events, and even larger ones seem to want to allow it. The issue is that people forget to un-sync the controllers and that makes a permanent extra player on the machine. This of course stops the matches form being played and slows the whole thing down. So you need to talk to the TOs of events and find out if it is a problem. You may need to find a GameCube controller if they don't want to play nice.
Any info on how they feel about wavebird controllers? As far as I know, that's the only GC controller I have that works. My other two are busted in some way or another.

Anyone can correct me if I'm wrong, but I have heard that all types of controllers (including GameCube, 3DS, and the wii/wiiu controllers) have a 4 frame lag to keep them all balanced. The argument against Wavebirds is that they introduce more lag because of the radio signal's travel time. I'm not able to tell you with any amount of certainty what that number is, but it will be in addition to the 4 frames. I don't see why anyone would not allow you to use them. If anything you're only hurting yourself.
